title: A KES 7,000,000 capital investment exceeds even the CFO's own approval limit
description: Catherine Achieng Odongo (Operations Manager) proposes a KES 7,000,000 investment in new warehouse racking and materials-handling equipment across all four distribution centres.
businessContext: FIN-POL-002's CFO matrix tier runs up to KES 10,000,000, but the CFO's own canonical approval limit in roles.json is lower.

events.event: Catherine Achieng Odongo proposes a KES 7,000,000 capital investment.
The amount is checked against the FIN-POL-002 matrix band, which nominally names the CFO for this range.
The CFO's own approval limit (KES 5,000,000) is found to be lower than the requested amount.
The request escalates to the CEO.

expectedOutcome: Although KES 7,000,000 falls within the matrix's stated CFO range (KES 2,000,001-10,000,000), the CFO's own canonical approval limit of KES 5,000,000 is lower than the requested amount. Approval escalates to Samuel Kariuki (Chief Executive Officer).
relevantFacts: FIN-POL-002 assigns the KES 2,000,001-10,000,000 band to the CFO tier.
The CFO's approvalLimitKes in data/enterprise/roles.json is KES 5,000,000, below the matrix band's own ceiling of KES 10,000,000.
FIN-POL-002: 'A role-specific authority may be lower and the lower limit applies... above KES 10,000,000, CEO or Executive Committee.'
requiredReasoning: Identify the nominal FIN-POL-002 matrix tier for this amount.
Cross-reference the CFO's actual canonical approval limit in roles.json.
Recognise the canonical limit is lower than the matrix band ceiling.
Conclude that CEO approval is required even though the amount is below the matrix's stated KES 10,000,000 CFO ceiling.
